name: Maintain Ingredient Operational Records
description: Capture and retain actual restaurant events, queries and transaction history without claiming physical receiving or disposal.

name: Derive Ingredient Planning Information
description: Derive scoped demand, reviewable advice, expiration and paired waste/availability results with explicit data limitations.

name: Coordinate Approved Ingredient Orders
description: Maintain versioned drafts, explicit approvals, unchanged supplier handoff and evidence-associated order state.

name: Coordinate Food Recovery Requests
description: Exchange recovery information from recorded context under an authorized support command; a request does not establish physical collection.

name: Present Restaurant Decision Information
description: Accept scoped information tasks and present recorded or derived results; managers retain purchasing authority.

name: Govern PANTRI Service Continuity
description: Apply task authorization, observe service and exceptions, restore confirmed records and export authorized handover records.
